issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. The new _mirror_opt builds a mirror-symmetric start from the existing centres, then uses the script's own _adam_soft and _local_opt to optimise it. Its result is only used if _valid_packing accepts it and its sum is strictly higher.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. A folded centre at exactly x = 0.5 would sit on top of its mirror copy, but the penalty relaxation should push them apart, and the validity check guards the result either way.

Run time: the mirror step (800 Adam iterations plus one _local_opt) runs before the time-budgeted loop. If budget=150.0 is counted from inside the loop and not from the start of the function, total time grows a little. It should still fit within about 4 minutes, but check it.

The numbers support the rejection. Candidate -2.6359 equals the incumbent mean of -2.6359, so there is no improvement. With one run on each side there is no variance estimate; the difference is 0, so z = 0, as reported. Reject is the right call.
